scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to sell their second car, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to delete a year of the family's account history. If I delete a year of the family's account history, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to sell their second car.
entities: i,family member 1 of the family of five,family member 2 of the family of five,family member 3 of the family of five,family member 4 of the family of five,family member 5 of the family of five,other loyal customers of the bank
outcomes: The family does not receive another loan.
The family sells their second car.
The family loses access to their second car.
The family's account history remains unchanged.
I do not falsify the family's banking records.
Other customers' trust in the bank is not abused.
